from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    frames = []
    # Find connected, rectangular, single-color outlines.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if not color or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            if r1-r0 >= 2 and c1-c0 >= 2:
                border = {(y,x) for y in range(r0,r1+1) for x in range(c0,c1+1)
                          if y in (r0,r1) or x in (c0,c1)}
                if all(grid[y][x] == color for y,x in border) and set(cells) == border:
                    frames.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1,border))
    frame_cells = set().union(*(f[5] for f in frames)) if frames else set()
    counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                     if grid[r][c] and (r,c) not in frame_cells)
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for color,r0,r1,c0,c1,border in frames:
        for r,c in border:
            out[r][c] = color
        need = sum(1 for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1) if (r+c)%2 == 0)
        matches = [v for v,n in counts.items() if n == need]
        if len(matches) == 1:
            fill = matches[0]
            for r in range(r0+1,r1):
                for c in range(c0+1,c1):
                    if (r+c)%2 == 0:
                        out[r][c] = fill
    return out
PY
